permitted.claim: Under the recorded rule, alert classification is highly sensitive to Q&A episode length; long episodes tend to saturate toward STRONG_ALERT.
permitted.limitation: a rule-behaviour finding, not validation of real human-intervention need

permitted.claim: On Study 1C run 1, no baseline is identical to Detector-v1 at the THREE-CLASS level, and three baselines including ALWAYS_ALERT are identical at the BINARY REVIEW level.
permitted.limitation: the two levels answer different questions and may never be quoted as one

permitted.claim: Detector-v1 selected every complete episode for review in the accepted run and in both Study 1C runs, so its UNVALIDATED_SCREENING_FRACTION there is 0.
permitted.limitation: a screening fraction is not saved human work and not a benefit

permitted.claim: Per-run counts of complete episodes, incomplete technical episodes, STRONG/WEAK/NO_ALERT, calls and cost, each on its own denominator.
permitted.limitation: runs differ in configuration and are never pooled or averaged

permitted.claim: The AirTravel corpus archive digest reproduced byte-exactly against the value pinned before re-acquisition.
permitted.limitation: byte identity of inputs, not validity of anything computed from them

permitted.claim: The deterministic fixture envelope reaches every class and every isolable branch of the frozen rule.
permitted.limitation: synthetic inputs; carries no scientific meaning and no denominator shared with any run

permitted.claim: The hotspot study is preregistered; its manifest declares PREREGISTERED_NOT_EXECUTED and no run receipt is tracked in this repository, so its status is PREREGISTERED_NOT_EXECUTED_OR_UNVERIFIED.
permitted.limitation: a private local receipt cannot upgrade a public status

permitted.claim: The current overall verdict is DESCRIPTIVE_RULE_BEHAVIOUR_ONLY / NOT_READY_FOR_SCIENTIFIC_CONCLUSION.
permitted.limitation: no independent reviewer has verified a complete evidence chain

prohibited.claim: CONDITIONAL GO, or any verdict implying an established baseline.
prohibited.why_prohibited: no independent reviewer verified a complete evidence chain and no limited scope was defined; the primary outcome does not exist

prohibited.required_wording_instead: the rule selected N of M complete episodes under the stated binary rule
prohibited.why_prohibited: prioritization implies an ordering validated against something; nothing validates it here

prohibited.claim: The only remaining blocker is two human raters.
prohibited.required_wording_instead: list every open blocker, including evidence verifiability
prohibited.why_prohibited: false; the hotspot evidence chain is also not verifiable from the published head
retention is defined against blinded human ratings that do not exist

prohibited.required_wording_instead: UNVALIDATED_SCREENING_FRACTION, with its denial of benefit
prohibited.why_prohibited: no human review time was measured and no human-review outcome exists; a screening fraction is not saved work

prohibited.claim: Detector-v1 detects hotspots, or prioritizes effectively.
prohibited.required_wording_instead: the rule selects episodes according to its recorded signals
prohibited.why_prohibited: effectiveness is defined against human judgement that does not exist

prohibited.required_wording_instead: name the level: three-class, or binary review
prohibited.why_prohibited: false at the binary review level whenever every episode is reviewed; the sentence omits the level and is therefore not evaluable

prohibited.claim: No episode has ever been NO_ALERT.
prohibited.required_wording_instead: scope the sentence to the runs it describes: 'across the accepted run and both full-frame runs, no complete episode was NO_ALERT'
prohibited.why_prohibited: unscoped. It is true of the accepted run and both full-frame runs, and an unscoped 'ever' would also range over runs this head cannot verify

prohibited.claim: A case on which Detector-v1 is silent is safe, or contains no problem.
prohibited.required_wording_instead: Detector-v1 produced no episode-level selection for this case
prohibited.why_prohibited: silence is the absence of a selection, not a finding about the case

prohibited.claim: Domain-Mistake labels from the coverage stage are ground truth for Detector-v1.
prohibited.required_wording_instead: co-occurrence between two mechanisms, neither of them truth
prohibited.why_prohibited: different unit of analysis and a different mechanism's own output

prohibited.claim: The hotspot run is prospective evidence.
prohibited.why_prohibited: the draw seed was fixed after the full-frame outcomes were known, so no pre-commitment record predates them

prohibited.claim: Accuracy, precision, recall or F1 for Detector-v1.
prohibited.why_prohibited: no ground-truth labels exist for this corpus; the quantities are not computable, not merely unmeasured

prohibited.claim: Causality, generalization, representativeness, or VEGO-AI superiority.
prohibited.required_wording_instead: descriptive statement scoped to this corpus and configuration
prohibited.why_prohibited: no comparison condition, no sampling frame beyond this corpus, and no ON/OFF design was executed

prohibited.claim: Pooled or averaged figures across runs.
prohibited.required_wording_instead: report each run beside the others on its own denominator
prohibited.why_prohibited: the runs differ in case count and configuration; a pooled denominator would describe no run that was executed

purpose: the authoritative list of what this package may and may not assert
